jobs.title: Senior Consultant / Project Manager -  Chemicals & Process industries
jobs.description:
The Roland Berger Amsterdam DNA
Roland Berger is a global strategy consulting firm that assists clients to grow and adapt to the challenges of today. Founded in 1967 in Munich, we are one of the leading representatives of our industry, with more than 50 offices and 3,500 dedicated colleagues around the world.
Our young, dynamic and fast-growing office in Netherlands employs 120 consultants and supporting colleagues. We are proud of the close-knit culture within our Amsterdam office. We are creative, dedicated, ambitious, entrepreneurial and passionate - and at the same time social, energetic, open-minded and respectful. We help each other to bring out the best in each other and the best for our clients. Besides our client work, we foster our office culture through many social activities together, from sports and drinks to office trips and celebrations of holidays.
What we offer
Your success is our success. We offer plenty of opportunities for development, (inter)national training courses and a mentor to support your development. In addition, we offer excellent benefits, including 30 days of vacation, transportation benefits, a non-contributory pension and a contribution to your health insurance.
What you will be doing
You will contribute to high-impact projects shaping the future of the chemical industry and its adjacent sectors. As chemistry is a critical enabler of industries ranging from automotive and construction to electronics and pharmaceuticals, you will not only address the challenges of the transition of the chemical industry, but create impact far beyond in both upstream and downsteam value chains. For example, the transition of the industry goes hand-in-hand with the energy and water transitions being equally intertwined with these challenges, and creating a wide range of questions that cut across industries and expertise.
You will work in (international) teams and collaborate closely with clients on core topics such as decarbonization, circularity, resilience & competitiveness and innovation. You will tackle complex questions at the intersection of strategy, M&A, operations, technology and innovation, from redefining strategies and portfolios and responding to changing customer needs and regulation, to transforming operations, developing new business models and driving innovation.
You will be at the forefront of an industry in transition, helping companies navigate uncertainty, solve complex challenges and build the future.
As a  Senior Consultant / Project Manager   at Roland Berger you will:
- Take the lead for modules in larger projects, and complete project management of smaller projects (typically leading three to five consultants).
- Coach and develop the consultants in your project teams.
- Have direct client contact and lead presentations during client meetings.
- Work closely with industry experts at Roland Berger.
- Contribute to Roland Berger’s knowledge development by capturing insights and drawing lessons from client work.
- Participate in office-wide projects (e.g. in-depth studies on current topics) that further develop Roland Berger or its thinking in a specific area or sector.
Who we seek
At Roland Berger we are looking for people who are genuinely interested in our clients and their challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work hard to deliver the highest quality. The values of “empathy”, “entrepreneurship” and “excellence” are the foundation of our work and our culture. We are looking for people who recognize themselves in these values, who can think big, dare to dream, see connections and make connections, are self-starters and can enrich our team.
Our requirements
- You have completed an academic university education (i.e. WO).
- You have between two and six years of experience in strategy and/or management consulting, and/or in strategic/business development and/or business roles at a large company.
- You have prior experience in the chemical industry or a closely adjacent industrial sector. Experience with areas such as specialty chemicals, ingredients, plastics, minerals, energy, water is relevant.
Healthy work-life balance
The right work-life balance is critical to performing at such a high level. We understand that this balance differs per person and life phase. Your mentor will help you to organize your work in a way that suits you and your goals.
Diversity
We believe that a team of unique professionals with a diversity of backgrounds and qualities brings out the best in each other and provides the best results for our clients. Our international character makes us very diverse as a firm; this is something we strive for in our office as well. We are looking for people who can and want to contribute to the office with their unique perspective and qualities.
Keen to apply?
Upload your resume with a motivation letter and grade lists (of high school, bachelor and master).
The application process starts with a review of your application documents, followed by assessment round consisting of a personality test and an analytical assessment. The personality test is completed individually and before the analytical assessment. The analytical assessment is completed via MS Teams and is selective. When the analytical assessment is completed successfully the next phase is the first round interviews, three interviews: one interpersonal interview and two case interviews. In the final phase, you will have two additional interviews and must present a case.
Our research shows that female candidates only apply when they meet 100% of the requirements while male candidates apply when they meet only 60%. So, if you recognize yourself in this role and meet at least some of the requirements, do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to receiving your application!
Do you have questions? Then get in touch with Maxime Jansen (Senior Recruiter) at maxime.jansen@rolandberger.com. We would be happy to hear from you!

jobs.title: Junior Consultant Summer Internship 2027
jobs.description:
When you join us as an intern, we help you become the best you can be. Prepare to expand your repertoire and learn about successful consulting from day one. As an integral part of our professional team of consultants you will be actively involved in the projects for our clients. With the guidance from your personal mentor you will constantly develop, as well as learn about life as a consultant.
This is an in-person internship in our vibrant, busy London office, and will run for approximately 8 weeks in July 2027. You could also be working on projects where you are expected to be on client sites. Hybrid working and travel are an important and expected part of this role from day one, so you should expect to travel beyond London across a number of locations.
Life as a Junior Consultant
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll work as part of project teams to help clients solve complex business problems and make important decisions.
Your work could involve analysing data, researching markets, building financial or operational models, developing strategies, exploring new technologies or helping a client respond to major change.
No two projects are the same. You’ll work across different industries, clients and challenges, giving you the opportunity to build a broad set of skills and discover where your interests and strengths lie.
You’ll be given meaningful responsibility from an early stage, while working closely with experienced colleagues who will support you along the way.
Where the Work Takes You
Hybrid working and travel are an important and expected part of this role from day one.
Our people work across a combination of locations, including the Roland Berger office in London, remotely, at client sites across the UK and, depending on the project, potentially at international client or project locations.
You may spend extended periods working alongside clients or as part of a wider project team, as well as working from the office or remotely.
You should therefore be comfortable working flexibly across different environments and travelling regularly, sometimes at short notice, to meet the needs of your projects and clients.
Learning without Limits
When you join Roland Berger, you’ll be aligned to our Transaction & Investor Support (TIS) platform as your primary area of focus, with particular opportunities across Regulated & Infrastructure and Industrials. We are also continuing to build and strengthen our Value Creation Proposition across these areas, creating exciting opportunities to support clients throughout the investment and value creation lifecycle.
Your platform alignment provides a clear starting point for your development and helps build deep expertise in our core areas of growth. However, it does not limit the range of projects, clients or topics you can experience.
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work across different platforms, industries and topics depending on the needs of our business and our clients. This breadth is an important part of developing into a well-rounded consultant and means you may find yourself working on challenges and in sectors that are new to you when you join.
The internship is designed for students completing their  Bachelors or Masters degree of all study fields in their penultimate/ final year of their degree.
You must be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:1 equivalent or above in either 2027 or 2028 , Offers of employment are conditional following satisfactory referencing checks, including the right to work in the UK. Candidates that do not meet the criteria will be withdrawn.
What you’ll bring
We know that great consultants come from many different backgrounds, and your degree subject is only one part of what you bring to the table.
We’re particularly interested in candidates who have developed strong analytical thinking, quantitative reasoning, structured problem-solving and commercial awareness. Degrees in STEM, management and economics-related subjects can provide a strong foundation for these skills. Equally, candidates from humanities, languages, law, social sciences and other disciplines can bring valuable strengths of their own, from research and critical thinking to communicating complex ideas, building compelling arguments and seeing problems from different perspectives.
What matters most is how you think, how you approach problems and how effectively you can turn information into insight. You’ll need to be able to structure information clearly, analyse and challenge what you see, and communicate your ideas confidently in both written and verbal English. We’re looking for people who are genuinely curious about business and consulting, enjoy learning quickly and are motivated by solving challenging problems.
Consulting is also a highly collaborative and mobile profession. From the outset, you will have the opportunity to work across different platforms, so an openness to learning about new industries, clients and challenges is essential.
Skills that will help you stand out
Alongside the core qualities, there are some skills and experiences that can give you an additional advantage. strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with data, analysis or modelling, are highly valuable. Existing work experience is advantageous but not required. Work experience doesn’t need to be a traditional internship, it could be a combination of part-time work, internships, volunteering, academic projects or other experiences can all demonstrate the skills and behaviours we’re looking for.
We’re also increasingly interested in AI literacy, not simply knowing how to use AI tools, but understanding how they can be applied effectively and responsibly to research, analysis, problem-solving and productivity.
Other experiences can be equally valuable. Additional languages, particularly European languages, can be an advantage in our international environment, while consulting or consulting-adjacent internships can give you useful exposure to the way we work. Leadership, entrepreneurial initiative and evidence of strong problem-solving can come from anywhere whether through employment, university projects, societies, sport, volunteering or extracurricular activities.

Herken jij je in onderstaande kwalificaties, competenties en vaardigheden?
• Je hebt een WO-opleiding met goede resultaten afgerond
• Je hebt 0 tot 4 jaar ervaring in strategy en/of management consulting of in strategische en/of operationele rollen bij een groot bedrijf of in de publieke sector (ervaring/competenties in retail, FMCG, marketing & sales, life sciences, financial services of energy is een pré)
• of je hebt een PhD met goede resultaten afgerond
• Je kunt analytisch denken en helder structureren
• Je werkt nauwkeurig
• Je hebt een ruimdenkende persoonlijkheid
• Je hebt goede mondelinge, schriftelijke en presentatievaardigheden en beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend
Wat is ons DNA?
Wij zijn één van 's werelds grootste adviesbureaus op het gebied van strategie en het enige met een Europese achtergrond, opgericht in 1967. Met meer dan 50 kantoren wereldwijd is Roland Berger een toonaangevende speler. Ons kantoor in Amsterdam wordt gekenmerkt door professionele en ambitieuze medewerkers met diverse achtergronden en nationaliteiten. Wij hechten veel waarde aan onze drie kernwaarden: 'entrepreneurship', 'excellence' en 'empathy'. Deze waarden vormen de basis van ons werk als consultants, onze interactie met klanten, zakenpartners en gemeenschappen, en bepalen onze bedrijfscultuur. Wij helpen elkaar om het beste in elkaar en het beste voor onze klanten naar boven te halen. Naast ons werk ondernemen we samen veel sociale activiteiten, van sporten en borrelen tot kantoorreizen en vieringen van Sinterklaas en Nieuwjaar.
Wat bieden we jou?
‘You create impact, we make it work’. Daarom steunen we je volop in je groei met jaarlijkse (inter)nationale trainingsdagen, een mentor die je ontwikkeling ondersteunt, de mogelijkheid om een studie of opleiding te volgen aan een prestigieuze business school en leiderschapstrainingen op maat. Je krijgt, naast een competitief salaris, uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Denk aan 30 vakantiedagen, een elektrische leaseauto, een premievrij pensioen en een bijdrage aan zowel je zorgverzekering als je sportabonnement. Bovendien bieden we je veel flexibiliteit voor een goede work-life balance. De combinatie van al deze factoren maakt Roland Berger tot een geweldige werkplek.
Diversiteit
Bij Roland Berger Amsterdam vind je een diversiteit aan mensen. Met verschillende nationaliteiten in huis verschillen we in cultuur, religie en etniciteit. Dat vinden wij belangrijk, want de variatie in standpunten en kwaliteiten geeft ons werk meer inspiratie, met toenemende creativiteit en succes. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis voelt. Om die reden is onze voertaal intern Engels, en vieren we naast de Nederlandse feestdagen zoals Sinterklaas en Kerst ook Diwali, Eid al-Fitr en Ketikoti. Naast Pride Week besteden we ook aandacht aan alle vormen van diversiteit met onze eigen wereldwijde Diversity Week.
Gezonde balans
Wij presteren op hoog niveau, en dat kan alleen als de balans tussen werk en privé goed is. We begrijpen dat die balans verschilt per persoon en levensfase. Omdat wij projectmatig werken, is er vaak ruimte om met je projectmanager je werk zo in te delen dat je voldoende tijd hebt om te sporten, je kinderen op te halen of met vrienden een hapje te eten. Alles bij ons is maatwerk.

Sollicitatieproces
Het sollicitatieproces bestaat uit drie onderdelen. De assessment ronde bestaat uit een persoonlijkheidstest en een analytisch assessment. De persoonlijkheidstest maak je zelfstandig en voltooi je voorafgaand aan het analytische assessment. Het analytisch assessment is selecterend en vindt plaats bij ons op kantoor. Indien je het analytische assessment met positief resultaat afrondt, gaan de eerste ronde interviews door zoals gepland. Deze ronde bestaat uit een case interview en een persoonlijk interview. Alleen als deze interviews een positieve uitkomst hebben, word je uitgenodigd voor de Final Day. De Final Day bestaat uit twee (case) interviews waarbij je spreekt met verschillende partners en/of principals en een written case inclusief presentatie. Aan het einde van deze dag word je direct geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van jouw proces.
Ben je enthousiast?
Upload je motivatie samen met je CV en cijferlijsten van je studie(s) en middelbare school via onze site www.rolandberger.com.
Uit onderzoek blijkt dat vrouwelijke kandidaten pas solliciteren als ze 100% aan de vereisten voldoen, terwijl mannelijke kandidaten al bij 60% solliciteren. Dus als je je herkent in de uitdaging en ten minste een aantal vereisten, twijfel dan niet. Wij zien je sollicitatie graag tegemoet!

jobs.title: Junior Consultant 2027
jobs.description:
Life as a Junior Consultant
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll work as part of project teams to help clients solve complex business problems and make important decisions.
Your work could involve analysing data, researching markets, building financial or operational models, developing strategies, exploring new technologies or helping a client respond to major change.
No two projects are the same. You’ll work across different industries, clients and challenges, giving you the opportunity to build a broad set of skills and discover where your interests and strengths lie.
You’ll be given meaningful responsibility from an early stage, while working closely with experienced colleagues who will support you along the way.
Where the Work Takes You
Hybrid working and travel are an important and expected part of this role from day one.
Our people work across a combination of locations, including the Roland Berger office in London, remotely, at client sites across the UK and, depending on the project, potentially at international client or project locations.
You may spend extended periods working alongside clients or as part of a wider project team, as well as working from the office or remotely.
You should therefore be comfortable working flexibly across different environments and travelling regularly, sometimes at short notice, to meet the needs of your projects and clients.
Learning without Limits
When you join Roland Berger, you’ll be aligned to our Transaction & Investor Support (TIS) platform as your primary area of focus, with particular opportunities across Regulated & Infrastructure and Industrials. We are also continuing to build and strengthen our Value Creation Proposition across these areas, creating exciting opportunities to support clients throughout the investment and value creation lifecycle.
Your platform alignment provides a clear starting point for your development and helps build deep expertise in our core areas of growth. However, it does not limit the range of projects, clients or topics you can experience.
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work across different platforms, industries and topics depending on the needs of our business and our clients. This breadth is an important part of developing into a well-rounded consultant and means you may find yourself working on challenges and in sectors that are new to you when you join.
What you’ll bring
We know that great consultants come from many different backgrounds, and your degree subject is only one part of what you bring to the table.
We’re particularly interested in candidates who have developed strong analytical thinking, quantitative reasoning, structured problem-solving and commercial awareness. Degrees in STEM, management and economics-related subjects can provide a strong foundation for these skills. Equally, candidates from humanities, languages, law, social sciences and other disciplines can bring valuable strengths of their own, from research and critical thinking to communicating complex ideas, building compelling arguments and seeing problems from different perspectives.
What matters most is how you think, how you approach problems and how effectively you can turn information into insight. You’ll need to be able to structure information clearly, analyse and challenge what you see, and communicate your ideas confidently in both written and verbal English. We’re looking for people who are genuinely curious about business and consulting, enjoy learning quickly and are motivated by solving challenging problems.
You should be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:1 equivalent or above in either 2026 or 2027, and have gained at least eight weeks of work experience. This doesn’t need to be a traditional internship, a combination of part-time work, internships, volunteering, academic projects or other experiences can all demonstrate the skills and behaviours we’re looking for.
Consulting is also a highly collaborative and mobile profession. From the outset, you will have the opportunity to work across different platforms, so an openness to learning about new industries, clients and challenges is essential.
Skills that will help you stand out
Alongside the core qualities, there are some skills and experiences that can give you an additional advantage. strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with data, analysis or modelling, are highly valuable.
We’re also increasingly interested in AI literacy, not simply knowing how to use AI tools, but understanding how they can be applied effectively and responsibly to research, analysis, problem-solving and productivity.
Other experiences can be equally valuable. Additional languages, particularly European languages, can be an advantage in our international environment, while consulting or consulting-adjacent internships can give you useful exposure to the way we work. Leadership, entrepreneurial initiative and evidence of strong problem-solving can come from anywhere whether through employment, university projects, societies, sport, volunteering or extracurricular activities.
Ultimately, we’re less interested in a checklist of experiences and more interested in what you have learned from them, how you have applied that learning and the potential you have to grow into a great consultant.
Ready to Get Started?
Key Dates
Applications close: Sunday 18th October. Late applications will not be considered.
Pre-interview case study workshop: Week commencing 26th October for candidates invited to the first-round interview stage.
First-round interviews: Saturday 7th November, in person at our London office.
Start Date: We expect successful applicants to join us in Autumn 2027.
Before You Apply
Please make sure you understand the following before submitting your application:
- Due to the high volume of applications, only applications that include a covering letter will be considered.
- Tell us about your ‘why’,  your motivation for Roland Berger and consulting, specific areas of interest in the London office, and the experiences and transferable skills you would bring.
- Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable with the level of travel and mobility that consulting can require.

Application Process
1. Screening
We appreciate the time and commitment it takes to submit graduate applications,  which is why we are proud to commit to you that we don’t take AI shortcuts with our screening. Every application is reviewed by a member of our (human) recruitment team, with applications reviewed daily and typically within five days of submission.
We’ll consider your academic background, experiences, motivation and the skills you could bring to consulting.
2. Online Tests
If selected to progress, you’ll be invited to complete our online tests, designed to give us a further understanding of how you approach different types of problems.
3. Assessment Day & Case Study Workshop
Successful candidates will be invited to our interview assessment day, alongside a case study workshop to help you prepare for the interview stage.
4. Final Round Case Interviews
You’ll meet more of our consultants and demonstrate how you approach real consulting-style problems through our case interviews.
5. Offer!
If it’s a great fit from both sides, we’ll be delighted to welcome you to Roland Berger.
For any additional queries, please email recruitment@rolandberger.com and a member of our hiring team will be able to assist.
Reasonable Adjustments
If you require additional time or other reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please email recruitment@rolandberger.com. We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible and inclusive.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant | Restructuring & Performance
jobs.description:
Our Restructuring & Performance practice advises larger mid-market companies and international corporations on complex restructuring and turnaround situations across their strategic, operational and financial agenda. As part of our build-up in Greater China, you will help shape a growing team that supports both multinational groups restructuring their China operations and local champions navigating special situations.
Within holistic restructuring concepts, we define our clients' strategic targets and create the basis for sustainable success through full liquidity transparency, competitive cost structures and a robust financing structure. We then drive implementation rigorously through our Project Management Office (PMO) and our interim management capabilities.
Our projects demand analytical and social competence alongside pragmatism, a strong bias for implementation, and experience in managing diverse stakeholders.
Education & foundations
- Excellent degree from a leading university or international business school, ideally complemented by an MBA
- Strong business and finance fundamentals and a high affinity for numbers
- Outstanding analytical and conceptual skills, paired with a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset
- Business-fluent Mandarin Chinese and English; German is a strong plus

Restructuring & performance expertise
- First relevant professional experience in restructuring, turnaround or performance-improvement projects – in consulting, a CRO/restructuring environment, with an investor (special situations/distressed) or in a corporate restructuring function; experience in or with the Greater China market is essential
- Exposure to the design and/or implementation of holistic restructuring concepts across the strategic, operational and financial dimensions
- Solid command of integrated business planning (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and short-term liquidity management – in particular 13-week cash-flow forecasting, liquidity transparency and cash management in distressed situations
- Understanding of financial restructuring topics – capital and financing structure, refinancing, and the preparation of bank and stakeholder rounds – ideally with first exposure to the Chinese lender and stakeholder landscape
- Hands-on experience in operational performance improvement, i.e. supporting the identification, quantification and implementation of EBITDA levers across functions: overhead/SG&A reduction, material and procurement cost, labor-cost measures, working-capital optimization, and footprint/plant consolidation and make-or-buy topics – with sensitivity to local cost structures and labor regulations
- Confident construction of robust EBITDA and liquidity bridges (plan vs. actual, measures vs. volume) as well as scenario and sensitivity analyses
- Experience contributing to measure tracking and implementation steering through a PMO – including measure definition, maturity/"hardness" gating, and tracking impact through to the cash level
- A plus: exposure to cross-border restructuring, carve-outs and distressed M&A, and familiarity with European/German restructuring frameworks (e.g. IDW S6, StaRUG) for serving multinational clients in cross-border situations

Personality & working style
- Structured, results- and implementation-oriented, also under time pressure and in special situations
- Strong communication skills and confidence in interacting with management, shareholders, lenders and local authorities
- Cultural fluency across Chinese and international stakeholders – able to bridge Western parent companies and local operations
- Entrepreneurial drive to help build and shape a growing restructuring team in China
- A strong interest in innovative, AI-based solutions and the ability to apply new technologies and data skills effectively across complex questions

jobs.title: Junior Consultant Summer Internship 2027
jobs.description:
When you join us as an intern, we help you become the best you can be. Prepare to expand your repertoire and learn about successful consulting from day one. As an integral part of our professional team of consultants you will be actively involved in the projects for our clients. With the guidance from your personal mentor you will constantly develop, as well as learn about life as a consultant.
This is an in-person internship in our vibrant, busy London office, and will run for approximately 8 weeks in July 2027. You could also be working on projects where you are expected to be on client sites. Hybrid working and travel are an important and expected part of this role from day one, so you should expect to travel beyond London across a number of locations.
Life as a Junior Consultant
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll work as part of project teams to help clients solve complex business problems and make important decisions.
Your work could involve analysing data, researching markets, building financial or operational models, developing strategies, exploring new technologies or helping a client respond to major change.
No two projects are the same. You’ll work across different industries, clients and challenges, giving you the opportunity to build a broad set of skills and discover where your interests and strengths lie.
You’ll be given meaningful responsibility from an early stage, while working closely with experienced colleagues who will support you along the way.
Where the Work Takes You
Hybrid working and travel are an important and expected part of this role from day one.
Our people work across a combination of locations, including the Roland Berger office in London, remotely, at client sites across the UK and, depending on the project, potentially at international client or project locations.
You may spend extended periods working alongside clients or as part of a wider project team, as well as working from the office or remotely.
You should therefore be comfortable working flexibly across different environments and travelling regularly, sometimes at short notice, to meet the needs of your projects and clients.
Learning without Limits
When you join Roland Berger, you’ll be aligned to our Transaction & Investor Support (TIS) platform as your primary area of focus, with particular opportunities across Regulated & Infrastructure and Industrials. We are also continuing to build and strengthen our Value Creation Proposition across these areas, creating exciting opportunities to support clients throughout the investment and value creation lifecycle.
Your platform alignment provides a clear starting point for your development and helps build deep expertise in our core areas of growth. However, it does not limit the range of projects, clients or topics you can experience.
As a Junior Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work across different platforms, industries and topics depending on the needs of our business and our clients. This breadth is an important part of developing into a well-rounded consultant and means you may find yourself working on challenges and in sectors that are new to you when you join.
The internship is designed for students completing their  Bachelors or Masters degree of all study fields in their penultimate/ final year of their degree.
You must be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a 2:1 equivalent or above in either 2027 or 2028 , Offers of employment are conditional following satisfactory referencing checks, including the right to work in the UK. Candidates that do not meet the criteria will be withdrawn.
To be eligible for this internship, applicants must possess the right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this role.
What you’ll bring
We know that great consultants come from many different backgrounds, and your degree subject is only one part of what you bring to the table.
We’re particularly interested in candidates who have developed strong analytical thinking, quantitative reasoning, structured problem-solving and commercial awareness. Degrees in STEM, management and economics-related subjects can provide a strong foundation for these skills. Equally, candidates from humanities, languages, law, social sciences and other disciplines can bring valuable strengths of their own, from research and critical thinking to communicating complex ideas, building compelling arguments and seeing problems from different perspectives.
What matters most is how you think, how you approach problems and how effectively you can turn information into insight. You’ll need to be able to structure information clearly, analyse and challenge what you see, and communicate your ideas confidently in both written and verbal English. We’re looking for people who are genuinely curious about business and consulting, enjoy learning quickly and are motivated by solving challenging problems.
Consulting is also a highly collaborative and mobile profession. From the outset, you will have the opportunity to work across different platforms, so an openness to learning about new industries, clients and challenges is essential.
Skills that will help you stand out
Alongside the core qualities, there are some skills and experiences that can give you an additional advantage. strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with data, analysis or modelling, are highly valuable. Existing work experience is advantageous but not required. Work experience doesn’t need to be a traditional internship, it could be a combination of part-time work, internships, volunteering, academic projects or other experiences can all demonstrate the skills and behaviours we’re looking for.
We’re also increasingly interested in AI literacy, not simply knowing how to use AI tools, but understanding how they can be applied effectively and responsibly to research, analysis, problem-solving and productivity.
Other experiences can be equally valuable. Additional languages, particularly European languages, can be an advantage in our international environment, while consulting or consulting-adjacent internships can give you useful exposure to the way we work. Leadership, entrepreneurial initiative and evidence of strong problem-solving can come from anywhere whether through employment, university projects, societies, sport, volunteering or extracurricular activities.
Ultimately, we’re less interested in a checklist of experiences and more interested in what you have learned from them, how you have applied that learning and the potential you have to grow into a great consultant.
Ready to Get Started?
Key Dates
Applications close: Monday 4th January. Late applications will not be considered.
Pre-interview case study workshop: Week commencing 18th January for candidates invited to the first-round interview stage.
First-round interviews: Saturday 23rd January, in person at our London office.
Internship dates:  We expect successful applicants to join us from Monday 5th July 2027 - Friday 27th August 2027
Before You Apply
Please make sure you understand the following before submitting your application:
- Due to the high volume of applications, only applications that include a covering letter will be considered.
- Tell us about your ‘why’,  your motivation for Roland Berger and consulting, specific areas of interest in the London office, and the experiences and transferable skills you would bring.
- Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable with the level of travel and mobility that consulting can require.

Application Process
1. Screening
We appreciate the time and commitment it takes to submit graduate applications,  which is why we are proud to commit to you that we don’t take AI shortcuts with our screening. Every application is reviewed by a member of our (human) recruitment team, with applications reviewed daily and typically within five days of submission.
We’ll consider your academic background, experiences, motivation and the skills you could bring to consulting.
2. Online Tests
If selected to progress, you’ll be invited to complete our online tests, designed to give us a further understanding of how you approach different types of problems.
3. Assessment Day & Case Study Workshop
Successful candidates will be invited to our interview assessment day, alongside a case study workshop to help you prepare for the interview stage.
4. Final Round Case Interviews
You’ll meet more of our consultants and demonstrate how you approach real consulting-style problems through our case interviews.
5. Offer!
If it’s a great fit from both sides, we’ll be delighted to welcome you to Roland Berger.
For any additional queries, please email recruitment@rolandberger.com and a member of our hiring team will be able to assist.
Reasonable Adjustments
If you require additional time or other reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please email recruitment@rolandberger.com. We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible and inclusive.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
As an equal opportunities employer, Roland Berger is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.
We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join Roland Berger.
If you have any questions please contact the hiring team at   recruitment@rolandberger.com

jobs.title: Senior Consultant / Project Manager - Transaction & Investor Services
jobs.description:
The Roland Berger Amsterdam DNA
Roland Berger is a global strategy consulting firm that assists clients to grow and adapt to the challenges of today. Founded in 1967 in Munich, we are one of the leading representatives of our industry, with more than 50 offices and 3,500 dedicated colleagues around the world.
Our young, dynamic and fast-growing office in Netherlands employs 120 consultants and supporting colleagues. We are proud of the close-knit culture within our Amsterdam office. We are creative, dedicated, ambitious, entrepreneurial and passionate - and at the same time social, energetic, open-minded and respectful. We help each other to bring out the best in each other and the best for our clients. Besides our client work, we foster our office culture through many social activities together, from sports and drinks to office trips and celebrations of holidays.
What we offer
Your success is our success. We offer plenty of opportunities for development, (inter)national training courses and a mentor to support your development. In addition, we offer excellent benefits, including 30 days of vacation, transportation benefits, a non-contributory pension and a contribution to your health insurance.
What you will be doing
You will be a key member of our esteemed and expanding transaction & investor services team and you will have the opportunity to take the lead on and manage a wide range of projects. The team significantly contributes to the success of Roland Berger's Amsterdam office. Our widespread recognition and extensive network are key factors in our success. You will have the potential to build a robust presence and reputation among the investor community. In addition, Roland Berger offers commercial flexibility allowing you to develop on your own perspectives and approaches.
You will work closely with partners and (senior) colleagues serving a broad range of top-tier Dutch and European private equity and strategic clients. Together, you will focus on topics that are shaping global discourse such as the energy transition, mobility, digitalization, and innovative business models.
You will design and lead holistic commercial due diligence efforts in the context of M&A deals, as well as develop value creation programs for portfolio companies. Your work will be grounded in deep analysis of markets and businesses, close collaboration with industry and functional experts, and a clear understanding of what drives value.
At Roland Berger we differentiate ourselves by listening carefully to our clients and working intensively with them on tailor-made solutions. In doing so, you will help clients make confident investment decisions by identifying the true value of target companies and critically assessing their equity stories to unlock long-term potential.
As a  Senior Consultant / Project Manager   at Roland Berger you will:
- Take the lead for modules in larger projects, and complete project management of smaller projects (typically leading three to five consultants).
- Coach and develop the consultants in your project teams.
- Have direct client contact and lead presentations during client meetings.
- Work closely with industry experts at Roland Berger.
- Contribute to Roland Berger’s knowledge development by capturing insights and drawing lessons from client work.
- Participate in office-wide projects (e.g. in-depth studies on current topics) that further develop Roland Berger or its thinking in a specific area or sector.
Who we seek
At Roland Berger we are looking for people who are genuinely interested in our clients and their challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work hard to deliver the highest quality. The values of “empathy”, “entrepreneurship” and “excellence” are the foundation of our work and our culture. We are looking for people who recognize themselves in these values, who can think big, dare to dream, see connections and make connections, are self-starters and can enrich our team.
Our requirements
- You have completed an academic university education (i.e. WO).
- You have between four and seven years of experience in strategy and/or management consulting or in strategic and/or operational roles at a large company or in the public sector. Having prior involvement in >15 commercial due diligence projects is a requirement.
- You have technical affinity and commercial insight.
- You can think analytically and structure arguments clearly.
- You work with precision.
- You are open-minded.
- You have experience managing others and delegating work to more junior team members.
- You are familiar with/experienced in (financial) modeling (Excel), visualizing presentations (PowerPoint) and storytelling.
- You have good oral, written and presentation skills and an excellent command of the English language.
Healthy work-life balance
The right work-life balance is critical to performing at such a high level. We understand that this balance differs per person and life phase. Your mentor will help you to organize your work in a way that suits you and your goals.
Diversity
We believe that a team of unique professionals with a diversity of backgrounds and qualities brings out the best in each other and provides the best results for our clients. Our international character makes us very diverse as a firm; this is something we strive for in our office as well. We are looking for people who can and want to contribute to the office with their unique perspective and qualities.
Keen to apply?
Upload your resume with a motivation letter and grade lists (of high school, bachelor and master).
The application process starts with a review of your application documents, followed by assessment round consisting of a personality test and an analytical assessment. The personality test is completed individually and before the analytical assessment. The analytical assessment is completed via MS Teams and is selective. When the analytical assessment is completed successfully the next phase is the first round interviews, three interviews: one interpersonal interview and two case interviews. In the final phase, you will have two additional interviews and must present a case.
Our research shows that female candidates only apply when they meet 100% of the requirements while male candidates apply when they meet only 60%. So, if you recognize yourself in this role and meet at least some of the requirements, do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to receiving your application!
Do you have questions? Then get in touch with Maxime Jansen (Senior Recruiter) at maxime.jansen@rolandberger.com. We would be happy to hear from you!
